         MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)

FROM first_purchase

)

FROM cust_lifespan

q066.question: How does distance affect delivery time? (approx via location)
q066.actual_sql:
WITH geo_agg AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    AVG(geolocation_lat) AS lat,
    AVG(geolocation_lng) AS lng
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
order_data AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    (julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) * 24.0 AS delivery_hours,
    c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SQRT(POW(g.lat, 2) + POW(g.lng, 2)) * 111.045, 2) AS distance_km,
  AVG(od.delivery_hours) AS avg_delivery_time
FROM order_data od
JOIN geo_agg g ON od.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY distance_km
ORDER BY distance_km

  SELECT
    order_id,
    MIN(payment_installments) AS installment_count
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT

  SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_price,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
